study_design.exact_quote: This study employed a cross-sectional survey design targeting oncology health care professionals globally. The 'Oncology Healthcare Professional Digital Health Survey' was developed by alumni from the 2022 European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Course in Medical Oncology for Medical Students, in collaboration with the ESMO Young Oncologists Committee, to evaluate the adoption and perceptions of DH technologies among oncology professionals. The survey consisted of 27 questions distributed across multiple domains, including participant demographics, workplace characteristics, technology usage patterns, effectiveness, and barriers to adoption.
